title: Analyzing Polyline
statementMd:
As Valeric and Valerko were watching one of the last Euro Championship games in a sports bar, they broke a mug. Of course, the guys paid for it but the barman said that he will let them watch football in his bar only if they help his son complete a programming task. The task goes like that.

Let's consider a set of functions of the following form:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6f8951b8e4ae583d0fea0c48524efbb9c9d38134.png)

Let's define a sum of

*n*

functions

*y*<sub>1</sub>(*x*), ..., *y*<sub>*n*</sub>(*x*)

of the given type as function

*s*(*x*) = *y*<sub>1</sub>(*x*) + ... + *y*<sub>*n*</sub>(*x*)

for any

*x*

. It's easy to show that in this case the graph

*s*(*x*)

is a polyline. You are given

*n*

functions of the given type, your task is to find the number of angles that do not equal 180 degrees, in the graph

*s*(*x*)

, that is the sum of the given functions.

Valeric and Valerko really want to watch the next Euro Championship game, so they asked you to help them.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number of functions. Each of the following $*n*$ lines contains two space-separated integer numbers $*k*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ $( - 10^{9} ≤ *k*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$ that determine the $*i*$-th function.

## Output

Print a single number — the number of angles that do not equal 180 degrees in the graph of the polyline that equals the sum of the given functions.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
当 Valeric 和 Valerko 在一家体育酒吧观看欧洲杯的最后几场比赛之一时，他们打碎了一个马克杯。当然，两人赔偿了损失，但酒吧老板说，只有在他们帮助他的儿子完成一道编程题后，才会允许他们继续在酒吧看足球比赛。这道题如下。

考虑以下形式的一组函数：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6f8951b8e4ae583d0fea0c48524efbb9c9d38134.png)

对于任意

*x*

，将给定类型的

*n*

个函数

*y*<sub>1</sub>(*x*)，...，*y*<sub>*n*</sub>(*x*)

的和定义为函数

*s*(*x*) = *y*<sub>1</sub>(*x*) + ... + *y*<sub>*n*</sub>(*x*)

。容易证明，在这种情况下，函数

*s*(*x*)

的图像是一条折线。现在给定

*n*

个上述类型的函数，你的任务是求出函数

*s*(*x*)

的图像中不等于 180 度的角的数量，也就是给定函数之和的图像中的这类角的数量。

Valeric 和 Valerko 非常想观看下一场欧洲杯比赛，因此他们请你帮助他们。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$，表示函数的数量。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*k*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ $( - 10^{9} ≤ *k*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$，它们确定第 $*i*$ 个函数。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即等于给定函数之和的折线图像中不等于 180 度的角的数量。
</statement>
